summary: Completed frontend-only regression testing on the public Panificadora Carvalho app. New logo, hero and all 24 product images, filters/search, cart totals, pickup and delivery checkout, WhatsApp payload, confirmation state, and mobile overflow all passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified public URL at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. All category counts were validated (Todos 24, Bolos 5, Salgados 5, Pães 5, Doces 4, Lanches 5). Delivery without address is blocked; completed WhatsApp payload includes order and address. Currency assertions required NBSP-aware matching, but displayed values are correct.
rca of the issue: No application defects reproduced. An initial automation attempt had an incorrect Locator.first() call and strict currency-string comparison; the corrected test confirmed both flows and values work as intended.
